description: Draw a print-ready barcode and return it as SVG (or EPS) in millimetres, plus a link that opens it in the generator. Types: upc-a, ean-13, ean-8, itf-14, code-128, code-39, code-93, interleaved-2-of-5, codabar, msi, pharmacode, data-matrix, pdf417, aztec. GS1 retail types use magnification 80 to 200 (percent).

gs1.description: Data Matrix only: treat the value as GS1 data like (01)09506000134352(17)271231

magnification.description: GS1 types only: size in percent, 100 is the standard size

value.description: The data. GTIN types accept the number without its check digit.

x_mm.description: Other types: narrowest bar or module width in mm

name: make_barcode
